name: 灯織
text: 私が優勝なんて、おこがましかったですね
trans:
It was ridiculous of me to even think about 
winning, huh

name: 灯織
text:
力不足どころか、身の程知らずという方が
妥当だと思います
trans:
It's not even that I'm not good enough, 
I think it's more like I got too cocky and 
overestimated my own abilities here...

name: 灯織
text:
優勝を狙う、なんて
一体どの口が言うんだろうって──
trans:
"Aiming for the win"?
How can I even say something like that...

name: プロデューサー
text:
そんな悲しいこと言わないでくれ
俺は全然思ってないよ
trans:
Please don't say that about yourself.
I don't think that at all, you know.

name: プロデューサー
text: 灯織は、自分に対して厳しすぎるなぁ……
trans:
Hiori, you're too strict towards yourself, 
don't you think?

name: 灯織
text:
応援が少なかったのは、
私が応援されるに値しなかったということだと思います
trans:
I think the reason why I wasn't getting much 
support from the audience is because I wasn't 
worthy of it.

name: 灯織
text: 決勝前の自分が、いかに調子に乗っていたか
trans: I got way too overconfident before the finals...

name: 灯織
text: 恥ずかしくて恥ずかしくて……
trans: I'm so, so embarrased about myself......

name: プロデューサー
text: 灯織は決勝まで勝ち上がってきたんだ
trans: You've been winning until the finals, right?

name: プロデューサー
text: 戦うだけの力が、ちゃんとあった
trans:
That means you got the means to compete in 
this competition.

name: プロデューサー
text: 今回は、色んな巡りあわせが悪かっただけ
trans:
It's just that a lot of things doesn't line up 
this time.
